actions.description: The hypothesis has a real, actionable test plan now -- move it from Formulated to Testing
Real evidence confirms this hypothesis -- mark it Validated
Real evidence contradicts this hypothesis -- mark it Invalidated
Real evidence exists but does not clearly confirm or contradict the hypothesis -- mark it Inconclusive
No real test has happened yet, or a named prerequisite blocks testing -- the hypothesis stays Formulated/Blocked
Whether this hypothesis's current evidence actually supports any of the above is ambiguous enough that a human should decide directly

metadata.decision_context: Given a Hypothesis with a real test outcome, decide its status -- literally shared agent_id/task_id across agent-learning and SocialEngage, not re-namespaced per project

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
